source.notes: The Taleb-Ponche-Mirabel (1996) Van Laar activity coefficients for water/nitric acid/sulfuric acid 0.5/0.3/0.2 at 250 K. The three acids are already on their own basis, so the composition passes through the model's renormalisation unchanged. NeqSim reaches these through `ComponentGEVanLaarAcid`, whose `getActivityCoefficient` the port replaces; the static utility is the same expression without the phase around it.

derivation:
The driver ran the three static methods directly - they take the acid-basis mole fractions and the temperature and need no flash - and printed `gamma [0.008700227753081819, 0.7987122544877442, 8.824018478058464E-4]`.

azoth's `eos.van_laar_acid_activity_coefficients` reproduces it.
